name: Microbiological Fertilisers
description: Live bacteria and fungi that fix atmospheric nitrogen, release the phosphorus and potassium already locked in the soil, and turn crop residue back into humus.
note: Replaces the old shop's Physio category, which held the same products as Organic and carried no description a grower could use.

name: Biostimulants
description: Amino-acid, seaweed and microbial formulations that help a crop hold its yield through cold, drought, waterlogging and transplant shock.

name: Liquid Foliar Fertilisers
description: The liquid range, fed through the leaf or the irrigation line — macro-nutrients, trace elements and the adjuvant that carries them.
note: Slug kept as liquid-fertilisers so existing ?category= links keep working; the name now says how the range is applied.

name: Crop Nutrition
description: The feeding programme itself: basal dressings, top dressings and NPK fertilisers whose job is to supply the crop's macro-nutrients.
note: Replaces the old shop's Value category. Membership is the products that supply nutrients directly — a microbial product that makes existing nutrients available is filed under Microbiological Fertilisers instead.

name: Organic
description: Fertilisers whose nutrition comes from organic matter — humified carbon, humic and fulvic acids, amino acids and natural-origin trace elements.
